race.comment: Another race that brings together a few horses who clashed here last time out. ADKI (6) each way might be the safest play, just because of the advantage it is to be on speed here and you know that is where she will be. Might just be a matter of how much work she has to do from the wide gate. ARTPARK (4) beat her home by 2-1/4 lengths last time, but draws a touch wider this time and will need a little more luck in running. CHELSEA TOFF (5) ran fourth in the same race, beaten just over 2-1/2 lengths, and her big edge is the draw. If she can lob a handy spot, she'll be there at the finish again. CHOSEN VENTURE (3) was behind all of the three mention earlier last time and will get back, but was only first-up last time, so should have more improvement to come. FUGACITY (8) is on the back-up after running at Ballarat on Monday and he'll find this easier than that, and the start prior.
